cases.name: Kathleen N. Ryan Beggs
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She married Francis Beggs on May 5, 1945 at St. Augustine Catholic Church in Footville, and they shared 48 years together before his passing on November 3, 1993. Kathleen was instrumental in running the farm that her family acquired in 1973, and was devoted to raising her nine boys. Kathleen and Francis were faithful members of St. Augustine for more than 30 years, and also were faithful members of the Nativity of Mary Catholic Church in Janesville for another 40 years."
cases.narrative: On 6/14/2021, during a welfare check, her body was found in her garage with a plastic bag around her head and a pool of blood around her. Her cause of death was reportedly determined to be strangulation and sharp force injury to the neck.
